name: threejs-skills
title_zh: Three.js 十连装：从零到能跑的通关技能包
tagline_zh: 别从文档啃起了。十个技能覆盖建场景、加光照、调相机、导出模型，每个都带可运行示例，装完就能改着玩。
tagline_en: Stop reading docs. Ten skills cover scene, lights, camera, export—each with runnable examples you can tweak.
why_zh: 按真实开发顺序编排，技能间共享上下文，不用重复传参。示例代码刻意精简，去掉无关噪声。
why_en: Sequenced like real dev workflow, skills share context so no repeated setup. Examples stripped to core API calls—no noise, just.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Three.js r150+ 的常规 Web 渲染路径；不含 VR/AR、着色器调试、性能优化。
limit_en: Covers standard WebGL render path for r150+ only. No VR/AR, shader debugging, or perf tuning. Each skill outputs a single-file sample—no bundler or.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
